investigation_notes.Description: An anomalous Office 365 login for risto.pohjal@client.ee was observed from Lagos, Nigeria and the login succeeded with MFA present. The source IP is flagged as a VPN hosted by a Data Center/Web Hosting provider and carries a maximum security score (100), while device management status is unknown. Because the IP is high-risk (data center/proxy) with a very high reputation score and the endpoint/device posture cannot be confirmed, this alert is classified as High Priority.
